name: GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.7 model cards (huggingface.co/zai-org)
notes: GLM-4.5 card states 355B total / 32B active, and GLM-4.5-Air 106B total / 12B active. GLM-4.7-Flash card states 'a 30B-A3B MoE model'. Neither card makes any MLA claim, consistent with the config and reference-implementation evidence in model-cn-hf-transformers-ref-impls. GLM-4.7-Flash and later also carry a GLM-specific bespoke license (MIT on 4.5/4.6, 'GLM-5.3 License' on 5.3).
